item.title: Working Remotely from Italy Without a Work Permit: Why It Backfires
item.description: A non-EU employee who just moves to Italy and keeps working creates immigration, tax and social security problems. What the risks are and the clean alternative.

item.title: Working in Italy for a Company Abroad: Questions Professionals Ask
